operations.description: Read project documents by project-relative path, optionally by line range. Returns the editor's buffer when the document is open or unsaved, otherwise the saved file (source: effective), or the saved file only (source: disk). Every document reports its source, dirty state and revision.
operations.name: litria_files_read

operations.description: Orientation for this project: its name, what is selected on the canvas, which documents the editor holds open or unsaved, what Litria can do for each kind of file, the operations this connection may call, the server's limits, and a summary of what the disclosure policy withholds. Paths are project-relative; withheld paths are never listed or counted.
operations.name: litria_project_context

operations.description: Search project files for a literal string, in their text (target: text) or in their project-relative paths (target: path). Searches what the editor holds for documents that are open or unsaved, and the saved file otherwise. Matching is literal; case folding, when on, is ASCII only. Denied and unindexed paths are never searched and links are not followed. Files a .gitignore excludes are skipped and counted in skipped.ignoredFiles and skipped.ignoredDirectories unless includeIgnored is true; documents open in the editor are searched either way. Results are ordered by path, then line; a search that stops early says why in truncatedBy.
operations.name: litria_files_search

operations.description: Return a bounded neighbourhood of import relationships around a focus (a project-relative path, or the current canvas selection), out to a depth of 1 or 2, in a direction (imports, importedBy or both). File nodes carry their folder group and whether they are on the canvas; folder nodes stand for the folder groups the file nodes belong to. Edges run from importer to exporter, with the imported symbols, a provenance (sourceDerived with the syntax status, or manual) and whether the wire is drawn. Denied and unindexed paths are never nodes and edges touching them are dropped. Each node carries its freshness (current, stale or unknown); the summary is current only when every node is, otherwise partial or unavailable with reasons. A walk that hits maxNodes, the edge ceiling or the symbol ceiling says so in truncatedBy.
operations.name: litria_graph_query

operations.description: Return the diagnostics language servers have reported, per file: for the given project-relative paths, or for every file with diagnostics at or above minSeverity. Each file is available (with its producer, its diagnostics and a freshness of current, stale or unknown, with a reason), unavailable (the producer is not bridged, not running, or has not analysed the file), or noProducer. Unavailable is not the same as no errors. Denied files are never reported, and denied or out-of-project references inside a message are replaced with [denied] or [path]. Lines and columns are 1-based. A response that reaches a ceiling says so in truncatedBy.
operations.name: litria_diagnostics_list

operations.description: Propose changes; nothing is applied yet. A text.edit changes a document the editor holds: each edit replaces oldText, which must occur exactly once in the document, with newText, and expectedRevision is the revision litria_files_read reported. A file.create makes a new file holding text, only if nothing has its name (never an overwrite), and shows it on the canvas. When every change is ready they become one plan: apply it with litria_changes_apply. A plan that is not applied expires after ten minutes.
operations.name: litria_changes_prepare

operations.description: Apply a plan from litria_changes_prepare. Its text edits apply all or none: every document must still be the revision it was proposed against, otherwise nothing is applied (state conflict; propose again). Applied edits are in the editor, unsaved (effect buffer), each with its new revision. New files are created after the edits, each only if nothing has its name (effect disk; outcome created with the file's revision, or exists); if only some changes land the state is partial and each change says what happened. A plan is applied at most once; asking again returns the same outcome. If Litria is set to have a person review agent edits, the plan waits for that decision (state pendingReview); ask again later.
operations.name: litria_changes_apply
